expression: (http.host eq "phim.bluesia.net" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and (http.request.uri.path eq "/" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/list/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/movie/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/person/")) and not any(http.request.uri.args.names[*] == "_rsc") and not any(lower(http.request.headers.names[*])[*] in {"rsc" "next-router-prefetch" "next-router-segment-prefetch"}))
description: Blueflare public HTML documents: cache eligible, honour origin Cache-Control (s-maxage=600); RSC/prefetch requests bypass because Cloudflare ignores Vary
